title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1

entities.name: Dawn
entities.description: A young inventor of traps and detectors in the carnival safe zone who dreams of being claimed by the Benefactors.

entities.name: Rill
entities.description: A forager from the carnival wounded by wickerfolk on a raid.

entities.name: Sunset
entities.description: A forager from the carnival with an injured ankle.

entities.name: City
entities.description: The fastest and strongest of the carnival's foragers, who is revealed to serve Valgavoth and betrays his friends.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The hungry House-world that harvests fear; with the shift outside it can now hunt rather than wait.

entities.name: The Carnival
entities.description: A safe zone of patched tents and lights inside the House that falls to a monster army at the end.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Followers of the Devouring Father who see a place to survive by serving him.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The being the Cult of Valgavoth serves, called the Devouring Father by City.

entities.name: Benefactors
entities.description: A group fighting the House that claims talented survivors like inventors; Dawn hopes to join them.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: A massive monster that kicks down the carnival's fence leading Duskmourn's army.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Splinter-laden monsters that ambushed the foragers in the Boilerbilges.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Monsters that burst from walls to drag people away, which Dawn's scanners warn of.

entities.name: The Boilerbilges
entities.description: A deep region of the House where the foragers were ambushed.

entities.name: The Hauntwoods
entities.description: A region of the House associated with cellarspawn.

events.summary: Dawn sits on the carnival's border wall throwing stones at snapping roses, dreaming of leaving to join the Benefactors.
events.quote: Dawn sat on the rough stone wall that marked the border between the carnival's safety and the treacherous roses to the west

events.summary: Dawn sees the foragers returning and runs to meet them.
events.quote: Delight washed through her and she jumped down

events.summary: Dawn notes Rill's wounded arm, Sunset's limp and City's unharmed state, which she finds suspicious.
events.quote: it wasn't right for two members of a raiding team to come back injured when the third looked completely fine

events.summary: Rill describes an ambush in a cold room and Sunset reveals the attackers were wickerfolk, which the detectors were not keyed for.
events.quote: Our detectors weren't keyed for wickerfolk.

events.summary: Sunset reports another group of strangers with glimmers, and the narration recounts the great shaking and the new doors appearing.
events.quote: Strange doors had begun to appear outside the safe zones.

events.summary: City, urging the others to hurry, tells Dawn that things have changed and that Duskmourn can now hunt.
events.quote: And now, Duskmourn can do what we've been doing all along.

events.summary: City reveals a tabard with a moth's wings and invites Dawn to join the Cult of Valgavoth, serving the Devouring Father.
events.quote: There's still a place for those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father, among the Cult of Valgavoth.

events.summary: A massive razorkin kicks down the fence and an army of monsters pours into the carnival; Dawn flees.
events.quote: A massive razorkin was kicking down the fence, what looked like an entire army of Duskmourn's monsters following close behind.

events.summary: Dawn runs as the carnival falls behind her.
events.quote: Dawn ran, and the carnival fell, screaming, behind her.

relations.note: Reveals he serves the Devouring Father.
relations.quote: Beneath it he wore a tabard embroidered with the wings of a vast and colorful moth.

relations.note: Offers Dawn a place serving the Devouring Father.
relations.quote: those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father
Dawn was the only one who stumbled back, away from the suddenly menacing shape of her friend.
She shot City an uneasy look as she moved to support Sunset
